pages.title: Rocket Assembly
pages.text: Mars sent the component plan, not a finished vehicle. Build it on the $(bold)ORSA blast pit$(); nowhere else works.

pages.name: Rocket Stack
pages.text: Pad, engine, four fins, four hull, nose. Centered or it won't lock.

pages.title: Stack Order
pages.text: $(li)Full 3x3 pad on the blast-pit mount$(li)Engine one block above the pad center$(li)4 fins on its north, south, east and west$(li)4 hull blocks straight up$(li)Nose cone on top
$(danger)Off-center, the structure will not lock.$() Keep the blast trench under the center plate intact.

pages.title: Rocket Engine
pages.text: Printed on an $(bold)ORSA Fabricator$() at 15 kW: 2 Obsidian, an igniter, 2 Refined Acheronite, a Thermal Core, 2 Copper and a Blast Furnace.$(br2)The base of the rocket, on the centerline. Place it first.

pages.title: Rocket Hull
pages.text: Printed on an $(bold)ORSA Fabricator$() at 10 kW: 6 Iron, 2 Copper and a Refined Acheronite.$(br2)Print 4.

pages.title: Rocket Nose Cone
pages.text: Consumes the Acheronite Compass.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA considered that an acceptable trade.$()

pages.title: Launch
pages.text: Once the structure locks, load $(bold)6 Rocket Fuel Cells$(), board, and arm the launch from the cockpit.
